business_problem: NTT Ltd. was handling global shared-service incidents and requests through email, spreadsheets, and conference calls, which limited accountability, auditability, and the ability to standardize employee-support processes across dozens of countries.
solution_summary: NTT Ltd. digitized global shared-service work on ServiceNow by building the Service Issue Management app on App Engine and extending the pattern to legal operations with Flow Designer and Configurable Workspaces. Before the change, Global Business Services agents handled incidents and requests through email, spreadsheets, and conference calls, with little audit trail or ownership. Service Issue Management now gives business users in more than 50 countries one place to submit cases, while out-of-the-box decision tables and rules route work automatically to the right owners. Dashboards and reports expose SLAs, KPIs, and CAPA opportunities from the same case data instead of scattered manual logs. NTT reused the low-code approach for a litigation workspace that captures confidential legal data, supports regional visualization, and can generate executive-ready reports in one click, turning ServiceNow into both a workflow-standardization layer and a rapid application-delivery platform.

solution_components.name: Service Issue Management
solution_components.role: Acts as the centralized case-management application for shared-service issues and requests.

solution_components.name: App Engine
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code platform NTT used to build and iterate the custom workflow applications.

solution_components.name: Flow Designer
solution_components.role: Automates workflow steps and process logic for the legal application and related case handling.

solution_components.name: Configurable Workspaces
solution_components.role: Gives legal teams a digital workspace for managing complex cases with the right context.

data_flow: Business users submit service issues into the Service Issue Management app, where App Engine logic assigns work and tracks ownership. The same case data feeds dashboards, KPI and SLA reports, and CAPA analysis, while Flow Designer and Configurable Workspaces extend the pattern to litigation workflows and one-click executive reporting.
business_outcome: NTT Ltd. built its first app in 24 days, closed cases 65% faster, established one standardized digital process for shared services, and expects the legal workflow to cut executive-reporting time and effort by up to 90%.
metrics: up to 90% reduction in time and effort
